headline_seed: Tropical Storm Moke to cause more flooding as Hawaii recovers from Lala - NPR
draft_text:
Tropical Storm Moke is tracking south of Hawaii — but the National Hurricane Center warns it may still bring life-threatening flooding to the Big Island, where Lala dropped over 3.5 feet of rain days ago.

NPR and CNN both report up to 15 inches possible.

And that's the mews.
